 Primetime 4K Blu-ray
 Posted November 3, 2026 06:59 PM by 
 A24 is preparing 4K Blu-ray and Blu-ray releases of Lance Oppenheim's Primetime (2026), starring Robert Pattinson, Merritt Wever, Skyler Gisondo, Matthew Maher, and Phoebe Bridgers. The two releases are scheduled to arrive on the market on January 26. 
Description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. 
Special Features and Technical Specs: 
 DOLBY VISION/HDR PRESENTATION OF THE FILM IN 1.50:1 RATIO 
 DOLBY ATMOS AUDIO TRACK 
 Filmmaker Commentary with Lance Oppenheim, D.P. David Bolen, Editor Dan Garber, Writer Ajon Singh, and Composer Ari Balouzian
 Deleted Scenes
 "Take a Seat: The Making of Primetime" Featurette
 Production Diaries
 Behind the Score with Composer Ari Balouzian
 Six Collectible Postcards with Photography by Sinna Nasseri
 Optional English SDH and Spanish Subtitles for the main feature
 Source: Blu-ray.com |
